materials.name: HF-140
materials.peel_condition: 1 oz foil, float 288 C for 10 s
materials.notes: Halogen-free, normal Tg, low CTE laminate with companion prepreg PP-HF140. Thermal stress (float 288 C, unetched) at least 240 s; T260 above 60 min and T288 above 5 min (TMA); CTI at least 175 V. The sheet carries the KB logo and does not print a company name. Volume and surface resistivity are given in M-ohm cm and M-ohm and converted; dielectric breakdown is given as at least 45 kV (specimen, not per mm). Typical values are for a 1.6 mm specimen (7628 x 8) after the sheet.

lamination.notes: Vacuum press at 300-400 psi full pressure; heat-up rate 1.5-2.5 C/min between 80 and 140 C; cure at 180 C material temperature or above for at least 60 min; reduce the pressure when the cure temperature has been held for 30 min to release stress; cooling rate below 3 C/min. Inner layers are baked at 120 C for at least 60 min after the brown oxide treatment, and prepreg is tempered 12 h before use.

drilling.retract_notes: The guide lists drilling parameters by drill diameter (speed in krpm, infeed in m/min, hit count) for a laminate thickness of 2 mm on a Hitachi machine; vacuum up the dust and blow out the holes after drilling.

processing.desmear_note: Vertical or horizontal permanganate etching can be used normally; check the cross-sections under a scanning microscope.
